mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_logs (user_id, scenario_id, action_type, call_duration_seconds, risky_behavior_detected, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scenarioId}, #{actionType}, #{callDurationSeconds}, #{riskyBehaviorDetected}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, scenario_id AS scenarioId, action_type AS actionType, call_duration_seconds AS callDurationSeconds, risky_behavior_detected AS riskyBehaviorDetected, created_at AS createdAt FROM training_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_logs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND risky_behavior_detected = true

SELECT t.id AS id, t.user_id AS userId, t.scenario_id AS scenarioId, t.action_type AS actionType, t.call_duration_seconds AS callDurationSeconds, t.risky_behavior_detected AS riskyBehaviorDetected, t.created_at AS createdAt, s.type AS scenarioType, s.title AS scenarioTitle, s.steps AS scenarioSteps, s.stage_details AS scenarioStageDetails, s.sms_email_report AS scenarioSmsEmailReport FROM training_logs t JOIN scenarios s ON t.scenario_id = s.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
